description: Discover NEW keyword ideas from seed terms and/or a URL, with average monthly search volume, competition level, and top-of-page bid ranges. Use this for keyword research and content planning: "what should I target?". Supply seed keywords, a URL, or both. Requires Google Ads to be connected and an Ads account selected. Direct the user to rankparse.com/dashboard/integrations. Returns search volume and competition data, NOT keyword rankings; use the Google Search Console tools for ranking and position data.

geo_target_constants.description: Location resource names, default ["geoTargetConstants/2840"] (United States). Max 10.

include_adult_keywords.description: Include adult keywords in results (default false)

keyword_plan_network.description: Search network to estimate against (default GOOGLE_SEARCH)

keywords.description: Seed keywords to expand from, e.g. ["seo tools", "backlink checker"]. Max 20; provide these and/or url.

limit.description: Max ideas to return (default Google decides, max 1000)

url.description: A page or site URL to derive keyword ideas from, e.g. "https://example.com/pricing"

name: get_google_ads_keyword_ideas
